function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if a school bus is present). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• The “no‑seat‑belt” law applies to all vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks.
• Yield to emergency vehicles with lights/alarms. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during any weather that reduces visibility.
• Fog lights are allowed only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Hitching** | • Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and proper equipment.
• Hitching a trailer requires a valid license and proper registration. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of fire hydrants, on sidewalks, or in no‑parking zones.
• Parking in a handicap space without a valid permit is a $200 fine. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus until the lights are off and the sign is retracted. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Use the right lane unless passing.
• Do not drive in the left lane on a freeway unless passing or turning. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT** – [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) for road conditions and speed limit changes. - **TxDMV** – [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) for registration, licensing, and inspection requirements. - **Texas Legislature Online** – [https://capitol.texas.gov](https://capitol.texas.gov) for the latest statutes and amendments. ### Quick Tips 1. **Always obey posted signs** – they can override general rules. 2. **Use hands‑free** – keep your phone out of reach while driving. 3. **Check your vehicle’s registration** – expired plates can lead to fines. 4. **Know the school zone speed limits** – they’re strictly enforced. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular driving scenario!
